sloka: सुसंरब्धं तु सौमित्रिं लक्ष्मणं क्रोधमूर्च्छितम्।रामस्तु परिसान्त्व्याथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥ २.९७.१॥
transliteration: susaṁrabdhaṁ tu saumitriṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ krodhamūrcchitam।rāmastu parisāntvyātha vacanaṁ cedamabravīt ॥ 2.97.1॥

translations.english: Thereafter, Rama pacified Lakshmana, son of Sumitra who was violently agitated. He said to him who had swooned with rage:
